metadata.name: MiniMax-M1-80k
metadata.variant_policy: This record covers the 80K-output-budget checkpoint only. M1-40k is a separate intermediate checkpoint in the same RL run; -hf repositories are packaging variants, not independently extracted here. Vendor evaluation/recommendation: temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95; 80K is a separate checkpoint, not a runtime inference mode.

backbone.context_window_notes: M1 report/card state native 1M input and 80K output budget. The config upper bound max_position_embeddings=10240000 is not an advertised 10.24M validated context.

variants.name: lightning_attention
variants.rope: RoPE is documented for the softmax branch; no rotary operation assumed for linear attention.
variants.notes: Lightning Attention: I/O-aware linear attention with recurrent state and blockwise execution (MiniMax-01 report §§2.1–2.2).

variants.name: gqa
variants.rope: Partial RoPE, rotary_dim=64; final checkpoint base 10000000.

attention.layer_pattern: (7 Lightning Attention layers, 1 GQA softmax layer) × 10, 80 total; config.attn_type_list has GQA at zero-based indices 7,15,...,79.
attention.notes: Pinned config: rotary_dim=64 of head_dim=128; RoPE applies to half of each attention head.

moe.routing: Top-2 of 32 experts; shared_intermediate_size=0. M1 continued training reduces the MoE auxiliary-loss coefficient, but its final value is undisclosed.

components.normalization: RMSNorm, epsilon=1e-05; postnorm=true; DeepNorm scaling in the original Text-01 report.

architecture.parallelism_notes: Original MiniMax-01 report §3: expert/tensor/data parallelism, Expert Tensor Parallel (ETP), varlen ring attention for softmax, LASP+ for linear-attention sequence parallelism. Exact M1 deployment degrees not assumed.

training.optimizer: AdamW for RL, beta1=0.9, beta2=0.95, epsilon=1e-15 (M1 report §3.2); full inherited pre-training optimizer is not reasserted here.
training.lr_schedule: Continual pre-training: 8e-5 constant for 2.5T tokens, then decay over 5T tokens to 8e-6 (report §2.1). RL learning-rate schedule undisclosed.
training.data_total_tokens: 7.5T additional continual-pretraining tokens; lifetime total including Text-01 is not stated as one figure.
training.data_mix_notes: Natural QA from webpages/forums/textbooks; explicitly avoids synthetic data in the continual-pretraining QA pipeline. SFT math+coding account for ~60%, a separate post-training distribution.

alignment.sft: Cold-start long-CoT SFT on math, code, STEM, writing, QA and multi-turn chat; reflection behavior (report §2.2).
alignment.rl_method: CISPO: Clipped IS-weight Policy Optimization; clips importance sampling weights rather than dropping token gradients; group-relative advantages and token-level loss (report §3.1).

stages.name: Continual pre-training
stages.description: 7.5T additional tokens and gradual context extension from 32K to 1M.

stages.name: Cold-start SFT
stages.description: High-quality long-CoT demonstrations with reflection; ~60% math/code.

stages.name: 40K then 80K reasoning RL
stages.description: CISPO; 40K checkpoint is intermediate. Output length extended 40K→48K→56K→64K→72K→80K; full RL run uses 512 H800 GPUs for three weeks.

advanced.mixed_precision: RL output LM head raised to FP32 to align training and rollout probabilities; other compute/master-weight precision not fully specified (report §3.2).

training.stability_notes: Smooth context extension prevents gradient explosion; repetition truncation when 3000 consecutive tokens each have probability >0.99; small AdamW epsilon chosen for very small gradients.

open_questions: M1-40k and HF-compatible repackagings are not separate canonical records in this collection. Exact per-variant weight/dtype differences require future audit.
Unknown fields are deliberate; no optimizer, token mixture, full training precision or version deltas are inherited from neighboring checkpoints without source attribution.
